page.layout: One image: the outer front board of a bound book, with no printed text. Blind-tooled decorative border and central panel, two brass clasps on the left edge, and raised bands on the spine at right.
page.notes: The scan shows the binding of the book, not a printed page. The blind-tooled ornament (frame, central panel, corner and edge decoration) and the brass clasps are not text and are not transcribed. Brown stains lie on the lower centre and upper left. A small white label with a yellow dot is stuck to the lower right edge, probably a library sticker, and is left out. No printed words are visible.
